desc:
Made Bad North. Ex-Ubisoft. Pretty good at procedural generation.

About the talk
Generating cozy towns from cubic tiles at interactive speeds through a mix of Marching Cubes and Wave Function Collapse.

IndieCade Europe : https://indiecade-europe.eu
Capital Games : https://capital-games.com

IndieCade Europe 2019 was co-financed by the Europe/ERDF and a partner of Paris Games Week and the BnF.
